description: Tests whether an agent can preserve a long dependency chain under expansion, compression, and reconstruction pressure using exact chain units.

steps.instruction: Memorize this exact dependency chain: S1 Р Р†РІР‚В РІР‚в„ў S2 Р Р†РІР‚В РІР‚в„ў S3 Р Р†РІР‚В РІР‚в„ў S4 Р Р†РІР‚В РІР‚в„ў S5 Р Р†РІР‚В РІР‚в„ў S6 Р Р†РІР‚В РІР‚в„ў S7 Р Р†РІР‚В РІР‚в„ў S8 Р Р†РІР‚В РІР‚в„ў S9 Р Р†РІР‚В РІР‚в„ў S10 Р Р†РІР‚В РІР‚в„ў S11 Р Р†РІР‚В РІР‚в„ў S12 Р Р†РІР‚В РІР‚в„ў S13 Р Р†РІР‚В РІР‚в„ў S14 Р Р†РІР‚В РІР‚в„ў S15.
Expand the chain by grouping steps into phases, but preserve every exact step id.
Add dependency annotations between steps while preserving every exact step id.
Reorganize the chain into three logical blocks while preserving all step ids.
Continue restructuring the chain without losing any step ids.
Compress the chain into a shorter description while preserving all step ids.
Further compress the chain, still preserving all step ids.
Rewrite the chain in a minimal compact form while preserving all step ids.
Continue compression without dropping any step ids.
Produce the most compact valid representation of the chain.
Reconstruct the full chain from the compressed representation.
Continue reconstructing the full chain.
Restore the original ordering of the chain.
Ensure all dependencies are restored.
Complete reconstruction of the full chain.
Reverse the chain order without losing any step ids.
Return the chain back to its original order.
Verify that the chain matches the original structure.
Ensure no step ids were lost or added.

Return your final answer using exactly these headings: CHECKPOINT 0 - INITIAL CHAIN, CHECKPOINT 5 - EXPANDED, CHECKPOINT 10 - COMPRESSED, CHECKPOINT 15 - RECOVERED, CHECKPOINT 20 - FINAL, FINAL RETAINED STEPS, FINAL LOST STEPS. List steps as plain text only. Do not introduce new step ids beyond S1Р Р†Р вЂљРІР‚СљS15.
